'''Ricky Bignun''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Dagobah Regionals]] on 25 September 1999 with Operatives, according to Blake Senn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d60">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-dagobah-regional-9-25-99d60/ dagobah-regional-9-25-99], DeckTech (Blake "Zurai" Senn, 2 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-dagobah-regional-9-25-99d60/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
